messages:
Alex: Heads up — planning to push the inference runtime change this Thu 10:15 PDT. Need someone to kick off the canary and own smoke checks. Change is runtime flags + model pin; should be low-risk but we want a gradual ramp. Who can take the deploy and monitor?

Maria: I can start the rollout and drive the traffic ramps. Prefer 10:15 so infra autoscaling finishes. :+1:

Sam: I'll own smoke tests and quick perf checks. Smoke command I plan to run:```
./smoke_tests/run_smoke.sh --env=canary --tests=basic,latency && curl -sS https://canary.internal/healthz | jq .
```Plan is baseline -> first step 10m observe.

Lina: For cohorts my preference: EU mobile first (low user weight), then US web, then global. Suggested percents: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Stop criteria: latency +15% or error_rate >0.5%. Recommend enabling geo fallback to previous model for US web.

Jia: Rollback prep: we can abort the rollout via POST /rollouts/<id>/abort or via console. I will attach a short rollback runbook to the rollout and tag @oncall for 10:00-11:30. Also pre-created the previous model pin in case we need immediate revert.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment created: rollout_id=rl_20260315_01 start=1862345678 window=90m owner=@Maria

Maria: Ack. I'll start at 10:15. Ramp plan: 5% (EU-mobile) -> 20% (US-web) -> 50% (Global) -> 100%, 10m observe between steps. I'll post metrics/snaps after each step.

Alex: Quick rollout config pasted here for infra ops:
```yaml
rollout:
  id: rl_20260315_01
  steps:
    - {percent: 5, cohort: "EU-mobile", observe: 10m}
    - {percent: 20, cohort: "US-web", observe: 10m}
    - {percent: 50, cohort: "Global", observe: 10m}
smoke_checks:
  - smoke_tests/run_smoke.sh
  - curl /healthz
alerts:
  latency_pct_threshold: 15
  error_rate_threshold: 0.5
```

Sam: I'll post smoke test results after step 1. If I see anomalies I'll call out `!rollback` in this thread and trigger abort.

Lina: If we need to swap cohorts, prefer swapping EU-mobile with APAC-batch rather than changing percents mid-step — smaller blast radius.

Maria: Will do. I'll ping Alex 5m before start and update status here after each ramp. :raised_hands:

Alex: Thanks — @Maria ping me 5m pre-start. Good luck everyone.
